description: Defines a SwiftUI view 'QRScannerView' that wraps a UIKit view controller for QR code scanning using VisionKit and a custom DataScannerViewController. Handles QR code recognition and error reporting, and communicates recognized links to parent components.

classes.name: QRScannerView
classes.description: A SwiftUI wrapper for a QR code scanner view controller, managing its creation, updating, and dismantling, and handling scanner delegate callbacks.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: An NSObject delegate class for handling QR scanner events, errors, and recognized data, and relaying these to the parent view.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController, starts scanning if supported and available.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: No-op in this implementation, as UI updates are handled via the coordinator.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and invokes the parent's onDismiss callback when the view is dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Instantiates the Coordinator object to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error message to the parent component, ensuring only one report per error occurrence.
